name: Browser Tool
description: Owns the `browser` tool surface (launch, navigate, click, type, scroll, screenshot, evaluate, snapshot, tab_*, close, status). Dispatches to whichever browser-backend plugin (zendriver, playwright, …) the operator has chosen via config.browserBackend or the per-call backend arg. Both backend plugins must be installed alongside this one for the corresponding selectors to work; uninstalling either backend just removes that selector — the tool keeps working with whatever's left.
